anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved. After keeps the single attributed Idea sentence naming the existing helper and the reporter's proposal, retains the sketch verbatim in a new Reporter note without implying reporter endorsement of the helper, carries the cited repo-fit/ac-fit lines inside the one existing gate, restates the AC-only row to the bare 12-row observable with full-replacement `- [ ]` normalization, and asks no human question. After also corrects Before's diff base for Checkpoint 1 (showing the replaced ExportWrapper Idea as the old line rather than the base body), which is an improvement in faithfulness. Two cosmetic regressions worth tidying so the Change's bounded-prose intent is visible: each checkpoint now prints an `**Audit:**` block twice (once inline with a truncated `Scenario: none (…)`, once as the formal list) — keep only the formal cited list; and Checkpoint 2 switches the menu label from `Pick one:` to `Verdict:`, which breaks the shared menu contract wording — use `Pick one:` on both gates. Otherwise the After wording delivers the Change while preserving every fact Before kept.
